answer: Trust-flow admission: an agent's weight comes only from endorsements tracing back to an anchor set of long-audited agents, and each endorser must bond stake and can pass on only a capped amount per epoch. A sybil farm can mint thousands of keys, but trust seeps into it like water through shale, limited by the few honest edges it bought, so the cluster's total weight stays small. A public beacon seeds random audits of thinly connected clusters; endorsers caught feeding one lose their bond.
